selector-max-universal.message: Avoid `*` as a key selector: it is matched against every element on every style recalc. Scope it to a class, or use a direct-child `> *`.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Don't transition `all`: it also animates inherited properties (e.g. scrollbar-color) on the main thread and restyles whole subtrees every frame. List the properties you animate.
